categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou C*Core Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the design, development, and sales of integrated circuit products, primarily embedded CPU cores. Its main business segments include IP licensing, custom chip design services, and proprietary chip and module products. These products serve key areas such as information security, automotive electronics, industrial control, artificial intelligence, and advanced computing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in embedded CPU microarchitecture design based on RISC-V, PowerPC, and M*Core instruction sets, with over 40 CPU cores developed. It employs fabless manufacturing, outsourcing wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to leading foundries like TSMC and Hua Hong. Core technologies include high-performance CPU cores, AI neural network processors (NPU), quantum security chips, cloud security chips, RAID storage controller chips, and automotive-grade mixed-signal chips. The company also develops SoC design platforms integrating CPU cores with peripherals and security modules, supporting automotive functional safety (ASIL-D) and cryptographic standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automotive OEMs such as BYD, Chery, Geely, SAIC, Changan, Dongfeng, and Tier 1 module suppliers like Atech and Jingwei Hengrun. The company serves markets in automotive electronics (domain controllers, ADAS, powertrain, battery management, chassis control, safety airbags), information security (cloud security, endpoint security, quantum security), industrial control, AI edge computing, and advanced computing. It also supplies to large state-owned enterprises and research institutes in China for national strategic projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: All business revenue is generated domestically within China. The company operates primarily in Suzhou High-tech Zone and has subsidiaries in Tianjin, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Qingdao, and Wuxi. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong. The company collaborates with domestic automotive and semiconductor ecosystem partners and serves customers across various regions in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on upstream design and R&D of embedded CPUs and SoC chips. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to third-party foundries and assembly houses. It is positioned in the midstream design and IP licensing segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing chip design, IP cores, and custom chip services but not manufacturing wafers or packaging.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing open-source RISC-V CPU architecture, expanding automotive electronics chip portfolio, developing quantum security and cloud security chips, and growing AI MCU and advanced computing chip services. The company emphasizes high R&D investment (over 56% of revenue), focusing on high-performance embedded CPUs, AI neural network processors, quantum-safe cryptography, and automotive-grade functional safety. It aims to integrate AI and quantum technologies into existing product lines and strengthen domestic chip sovereignty and market leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of proprietary chips and modules, custom chip design and volume production services, and IP licensing fees. The company’s sales are mainly direct to customers with a portion through distributors. Custom chip services include design and volume production contracts, with increasing contribution from AI and advanced computing chip customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global semiconductor firms such as NXP, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Bosch, ADI in automotive chips, and ARM and SiFive in embedded CPU IP. It holds a leading domestic position in automotive-grade MCU chips, information security chips, and embedded CPU IP cores. It is recognized as a key player in China’s semiconductor industry, particularly in automotive electronics and information security, contributing to domestic chip substitution efforts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 574 million, a 27.78% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in proprietary chip/module sales and custom chip services. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -180.59 million, slightly larger than the previous year’s loss. Total assets reached RMB 3.2 billion, with net assets of RMB 2.19 billion. The company maintains high R&D spending, accounting for over 56% of revenue, reflecting its growth and innovation focus despite current losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully自主可控 (independent and controllable) embedded CPU technology based on open-source RISC-V and PowerPC architectures, enabling domestic chip sovereignty. It offers a broad and customizable CPU IP portfolio with high-performance, functional safety, and integrated security features tailored for automotive, information security, and AI applications. Its integrated SoC platforms, high reliability, and certifications (ISO26262 ASIL-D, EAL5+) differentiate it in the domestic market. The company also pioneers quantum security chips and advanced AI NPUs, positioning itself as a technology innovator supporting China’s strategic chip independence.
